KLANGITES have been hit by flash floods more frequently this year than ever before. Residents in Kapar and Meru have been the most affected in south Klang as parts of Taman Sentosa, Bandar Puteri and Kampung Jawa were frequently hit by flash floods. Already a subscriber?
